title: Very Disappointed in the Direction of This Game
text: I have played Franchise Hockey for a long time and have invested a lot of time into building my teams. Until now, I have genuinely enjoyed the game. But suddenly attaching advertisements to free training and free bonuses that players previously received without having to sit through a video is incredibly disappointing. There is a big difference between offering an advertisement in exchange for an additional reward and taking something that has been part of the game for years and suddenly putting an advertisement in front of it. You encouraged people to play every day, build their franchises and invest countless hours into the game under one system. Once those players are invested, changing that system to squeeze additional advertising revenue out of the same activities feels like a bait-and-switch. And it’s not happening in isolation. The game already has long waiting periods, paid season skips, in-app purchases and optional advertising opportunities. There were already plenty of ways to monetize the game without taking existing free features and putting advertisements in front of them. I understand that developers need to make money. I have no problem with reasonable monetization, optional purchases or watching an advertisement to receive something extra. But there needs to be some respect for the people who have supported and played your game for years. For you to make a change like this out of nowhere tells longtime players that their time and loyalty aren’t particularly important. I believe taking established free benefits and suddenly making players watch advertisements to receive them is an unethical way to monetize a loyal user base. If this is the direction Franchise Hockey intends to stay with, then unfortunately I will have to move along. That’s disappointing because I’ve enjoyed this game for a very long time. I hope enough longtime players speak up that you reconsider this decision.

title: New Updates Destroyed The Game
text: I don’t even know where to begin (get ready for a long read lol) I have never written a review on a game before. If I had an issue with a game, I have always just deleted it and gone on with my day, but I have to write this or I’ll genuinely lose my sanity. I use to play this game back in 2023-2024 on and off and it was amazing, by far the best sports GM game I’ve ever played. But I just picked it back up about 2 weeks ago and it has become the most p2w greedy, unbalanced game I may have ever played (besides clash royale ofc). I’ll break down my top 3 concerns below: To begin, high overall free agents used to be locked for you and as you progressed and made a better name for your franchise you unlocked the ability to sign them. This was great because making a name for yourself truly made an impact on players’ perceptions of your team. You simply unlocked them and then agreed on a contract. Now there is a whole convincing power system, it doesn’t seem bad at first glance, but after diving into it you realize just how ridiculous it is. Literally mid 70s overall players are requesting upwards of 30+ power just to convince, meanwhile they are back up caliber players that have no business even needing convincing, id say a six pack and a please should suffice to convince them, I should not have to spend my entire years worth of power that I have obtained. Additionally, decent overall, but old (32+ year old) players are still asking 40+ pwr half the time, when in reality they would be lucky to even get picked up by a team. The whole system is busted and aimed at making free agency essentially impossible. Secondly, don’t even get me started on contracts. The max I used to pay a 5 star potential, high 90s ovr player back in the day was like low 30 millions per year and that was literally your franchise player. Now I have mid 90s players asking for 50+ million a year, that’s literally almost half of the entire salary cap. Not to mention low 80+ ovr players are now in the high 20 millions after their rookie contracts and older 70s overalls are like high teens sometimes even breaking 20 million (they could be signed for maybe 7-12 million a year back in the day. Meanwhile, the AI is signing these same players for half the price I’m paying, I literally see high 90s ovr players on ai teams for mid 20 millions while it costs me the same amount for an 82 ovr. Ridiculous. Thirdly, the devs have absolutely gutted the trade value of players when on your team. Previously, if you drafted and scouted well and found yourself 5 star recruits you could develop them and trade them for considerable amounts of picks or other older players with high overalls. It was a great way to reward players for drafting well by allowing you to get value back if you have too many 5 star picks to start them all and you want to trade a couple. Now-a-days I’ll draft a 5 star talent and develop him into to maybe an 80-84 overall by the 2nd or 3rd year of his rookie deal; I try and trade him and he’s worth max 5000 points of trade value. The game says that it is a negative and that trade value is decreased because he is still on his rookie contract, meanwhile that’s FANTASTIC. Ur still paying a 5 star 80s ovr player in the 5-8 million range, when in reality (due to these absurd new contracts) is averagely priced at about 20-25 million a year. So the trade system is now horrible too lol I can’t even fathom how the devs thought that any of these changes were at all good. Don’t get me wrong, I love a good challenge, when a game is too easy it removes any satisfaction I get when succeeding. But this is beyond difficult, it’s outright ridiculous and makes the game basically unplayable. I’m sorry this was so long. If you made it through the entire thing thanks for giving me a minute of your time to vent haha. If you would be so kind leave an upvote here so the devs see this and maybe consider actually bettering their game and showing any regard for their player base. Good luck and I hope maybe eventually you guys can build a successful franchise.

text: Can I give zero stars? I have been playing all versions of football manager games for over 15 years on PC, android and iOS, this might be the first one that breaks me. First of all, why do some teams have to be so good that no matter what you do and what changes you make, you can never beat them. I play with Olympic Marseille and for some reason, they kept drawing me against PSG in all cup competitions and even in the champions league. I played PSG 6 times that season. Not the most unrealistic thing but then during the games, there was nothing I could do to beat them. I played low blocks, counter, possession, they always seemed to be better for all six games. Even for average teams, you just can’t beat them. I spent so much money on improving my team, and I knew for sure the only team better than my team was psg so I was fine with that. But for some reason, I’d beat Auxerre comfortably, and then lose to Reims 4-0 the next match. It’s TOO INCONSISTENT. I played against second division teams and they would always score to equalise the game and take it to extra time, CMON! The game isn’t realistic at all. I know everything is AI these days but this one in particular is trash, it is not realistic. I’ll be taking a break from this particular game until it gets fixed.

title: Like, but it is pay to play
text: I like it , but would like to play it a little more. It is literally a pay to play…it will only let you start a new season every 16 hours unless you buy a pass for just over $2. Otherwise seems pretty nice, I’m on my 42 season. A season is 21 games, and some playoffs. A game resolves in about 15 seconds, so it doesn’t take too long to play a season…..and then you are locked out of progressing to the playoffs and another next season for 16 hours…..unless you pay $6.99 for three season passes that allow you to wrap up the season and do the playoffs. The cost and competition continue to rise as you progress through the seasons but the payouts remain the same (from exhibition games or games in a season). Every 5 seasons you have a new Series of players that become available. In Series 1 a player cost 10m and has abilities in the 10-20 range. Each new Series the cost of players will increase by 5m (or every 3rd series will cost RPs). When I hit season 45, I will enter Series 10, and if the pattern stays the same, players will cost 40m each. Meaning eventually you can't keep up unless you pay real money. -1 more star. Interesting feature is building real teams of one line from the same real life team that can compete against their Rivals. I have 190 players that I have randomly accumulated over playing 42 seasons, and was able to complete two teams (Montreal and Edmonton), but so far in the Rivals options, none of the teams want to play either of my teams. Interesting, but only useful to someone who has 800+ players.....anyone? anyone? I’ll try to continue to Season 50, and update.

title: Welcome Back FM Mobile
text: I have been awaiting an update to this game for what feels like decades and it is such a delight to have the latest squads back in my FM life. The additional leagues are a lovely touch too. For the most part, the game isn’t changed much from FM24 Mobile. The mechanics are all the same. The graphics seem maybe a bit worse for wear. The financial regulations are an exciting addition, although they seem more so to mirror FFP regulations than anything else and it might be too easy to get to a point where you are receiving 100% of a transfer sale back into your budget. I have noticed a glitch thus far. It would seem every time load a save, my wage budget decreases while my transfer budget remains the same. I have been able to, in a couple of seasons, sell players and make money much faster than the game is taking it from me, but it is annoying to save a game with my wage expenditure just below my wage budget and reload the same save suddenly over budget. Overall: glad it’s back… hoping for updates fixing the glitch… wishing there were more steps forward coming out of a two year hiatus.
